internal.title: Incident Report: High Latency in Ad Service Resolved
internal.body:
At 11:00 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for high latency in the ad service. The p95 latency reached 1.8 seconds, significantly above normal levels. Initial diagnosis confirmed the latency issue was due to resource exhaustion, with CPU utilization at 98%. Error injection was ruled out as the error rate remained low at 0.2%. To mitigate the issue, the flag controlling CPU resource allocation was disabled at 11:20 UTC, which led to a rapid recovery of service latency to normal levels (0.12 seconds p95).

Timeline:
- 11:00:50: Alert received for high latency.
- 11:20:30: Diagnosis confirmed latency and high CPU usage.
- 11:20:35: Flag disabling action approved and executed.
- 11:20:35: Recovery verified with latency returning to normal.

The incident is now resolved. Further analysis will be conducted to prevent recurrence.
